entity: FirstEnergy's hand-read meters across its seven utilities
what_we_add: 2.26M hand-read meters in 2024, about 27% of all hand-read US meters, and the 57-83% state shares
why: News 5 and FirstEnergy itself put 1.4 million Ohio customers still without smart meters into 2027: same entity, same direction, far behind. The national-share math and the OH/MD/WV outlier rates appear nowhere. The 2026 Potomac Edison rollout-complete line is a later window, not a contradiction.
